Renderings: Gilgameš XI 1–208 (project glossary)

This file lists the recurring words of Gilg. XI that are not in the shared ../renderings.md. The shared file binds; this one extends it.
Format (guidelines §6.6): Akkadian lemma (eBL) | chosen Hebrew | rejected | reason | lines. Echo tags per guidelines §6.4.

Because Atra-ḫasīs III and the other Akkadian versions will copy this Hebrew for shared lines, entries marked (corpus) are proposed for the shared file too (see project.md, "Proposals for the shared renderings").

1. Formulas and fixed phrases

Akkadian Hebrew Rejected Reason Lines
X pâšu īpuš-ma iqabbi / izakkar(a) ana Y (SB, over two lines) (corpus) X פָּתַח אֶת פִּיו וְאָמַר, / דִּבֵּר אֶל Y: The shared one-line SB formula, split at the line break. The OB two-line formula (pīašu īpušam-ma / izzakkar ana Y) is X פָּתַח אֶת פִּיו / וְדִבֵּר אֶל Y: the difference (SB iqabbi) stays visible. 36–37, 177–178, 181–182
ana šâšū-ma izakkara ana Y X דִּבֵּר אֵלָיו, אֶל Y Shared formula. 1, 8
ina šēr(i) kukkī / ina līlâti ušaznan(akkunūši) šamût kibāti בַּבֹּקֶר – עוּגוֹת, / בָּעֶרֶב יַמְטִיר (עֲלֵיכֶם) מְטַר חִטִּים "לחם", "גשם" Ea's double-edged promise. Identical Hebrew in 46–47, 88, 91; עֲלֵיכֶם only where the Akkadian has -kunūši (47). 46–47, 88, 91
sebû ūmu ina kašādi כְּשֶׁהִגִּיעַ הַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי "ויהי ביום השביעי" (biblical calque) Literal; kašādu = הִגִּיעַ throughout (87, 90, 164, 172). 130, 147
šadû nimuš eleppa iṣbat-ma ana nâši ul iddin הַר נִימוּשׁ אָחַז בַּסְּפִינָה וְלֹא נָתַן לָהּ לָמוּשׁ "לנוע", "לזוז" לָמוּשׁ keeps the sound play Nimuš / nâši. 143–146
ušēṣī-ma X umaššar הוֹצֵאתִי X וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי(הָ/ו) Guidelines §7.2 example. wuššuru D ↔ וַיְשַׁלַּח (ח:ז–ח) [equivalent]. The fourth ušēṣī-ma (157, the offering) keeps the same verb הוֹצֵאתִי, so the series of four survives. 148, 151, 154, 157
illik X īpiram-ma / manzāzu ul īpâššim-ma issaḫra הָלְכָה X, חִפְּשָׂה מָזוֹן? / מְקוֹם עֲמִידָה לֹא נִרְאָה לָהּ, וְשָׁבָה אֵלַי מָנוֹחַ (ח:ט – false echo) 149–150, 152–153
ultu ullânum-ma X ina kašādīšu/ša מִיָּד כְּשֶׁהִגִּיעַ/ה X 164, 172
ammaku taškunu abūba תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר חוֹלַלְתָּ מַבּוּל Four identical lines. 188, 190, 192, 194
X litbâm-ma nišī/māta liṣaḫḫir/lišgiš יָקוּם X וְיַמְעִיט אֶת הָאֲנָשִׁים / וְיִשְׁחַט אֶת הָאָרֶץ šagāšu = שָׁחַט as in 72. 189, 191, 193, 195
ina rūqi ina pî nārāti בַּמֶּרְחַקִּים, בְּפִי הַנְּהָרוֹת Root רחק as in the epithet rūqu הָרָחוֹק (1). 205, 206
